implemented.details: 16 Shift/Ctrl/Option/Cmd combinations match existing policy; all raw modifier flags carried; marked keys go through AppKit without submit; reference source must be builtin reference identity codec, unknown/missing source and duplicate identity rejected.

Normalized adjacent text attributes do not affect content revision; style/selection/focus/completion do not change content digest. Digest includes occurrence identity and source, uses length-prefixed UTF8 SHA256 shared with Go. replaceSpan requires expected content revision+digest, validates UTF16/codepoint boundaries and proposed whole-document IDs before edit.

commitAccepted consumes existing ledger request ID+captured semantic runs/digest and current CAS. Exact semantic prefix only; new suffix and atomic IDs preserved. New occurrence with same canonical clipboard is retained. Confirmed commit cuts committed Undo; duplicate request remains inert even after user Undo. No transport implementation, model call, prompt command or retry ledger copied.

Stable account/Host/session/slot identity; callback epoch separate. Capture requires current epoch and deep copies semantic runs/attachment IDs for the future existing ledger. Unknown/invalid/marked cannot Capture; accepted semantic settlement defers while current content invalid/marked and can complete locally after valid recovery. Retire cools hot state and retains all semantic drafts/selection; no LRU deletion and no automatic disk persistence.

Native RetireDocument/RetireAccount require exported semantic digest proof and atomically reject incomplete account exports. Explicit removeAllActions on current and every saved Undo before owner detach, clear dictionaries and outer scroll document view on close. Only app-owned/public APIs used; no private MyGo viewGone, forced release, forced input context deactivation or forced undo-group endings.

Editor drops known old owner/doc/epoch/frame/content revisions, conservatively fences malformed current frames, and preserves the maximum prior invalid barrier across older/headerless malformed frames. Store.Accept failures fence Capture rather than exposing an old valid draft; only strictly newer current valid frames recover; same-epoch Bind cannot reset it.

interfaces.scope: accountScope + stable docKey + new epoch + semantic runs + seedSemanticRevision + explicit selection:{start,end} (UTF16)
interfaces.replace: Use replaceSpan with expectedSemanticRevision/expectedSemanticDigest. Legacy prototype replace remains unqualified for production adapter.
interfaces.accepted: commitAccepted requires confirmed existing requestId, committedRuns/committedSemanticDigest and current expectedSemanticRevision/digest. It does not authenticate acceptance or send RPC.
interfaces.retirement: retireDocument(targetDocKey,exportedSemanticDigest); retireAccount(targetAccountScope,exportedDocuments:{docKey:digest}); close clears all hot objects. Caller exports semantic drafts before retirement.
interfaces.store: Bind new epoch resets surface frame revision but retains content revision; same epoch no-op. Capture(id,epoch,attachmentIDs) returns immutable semantic payload. CommitAccepted only from future existing ledger accepted path. RetireWindow returns retained cold semantic copies; app must retain/export these beyond window lifetime.
